description: Search Korean tax interpretations (advance rulings, replies to inquiries, 예규, etc.) by the National Tax Service (국세청) and the Ministry of Economy and Finance (재정경제부) by words in the title (in the body with body_search), newest first. Search terms must be in Korean. Put a result's document ID (문서ID) into get_tax_interpretation to read it. Without agency, both agencies are searched. Interpretations are not law but reference material.

agency.description: 국세청 = National Tax Service (NTS) / 재정경제부 = Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF). Default: both

body_search.description: true: search the body instead of the title

query.description: Korean words in the title. E.g. 양도소득세 비과세, 부가가치세 면세

name: search_tax_interpretation
title: Search tax interpretations (세법 해석 검색)
